about_the_game:
You are a fisherman who enrolled in the "Fishathon", a 7-day fishing tournament that this time takes in place in the North Pole. The prize? A mystery, no one knows but yet every last one of your rivals will do anything in their power to catch as many fish as possible and become the winner, so be prepared.

FISHING & EXPLORATION

You can fish by approaching any of the ice hole you will find in the terrain. Each fishing session will deplete stamina and a casual minigame will be chosen, ranging from an old dungeon crawler that resembles a 80s game to a more classic MMO inspired fishing minigame, each with its own secrets and mechanics. Also fishing minigames are always cool so the more the merrier.

Exploration is also a very crucial part of Fishathon because by exploring, you can find secrets that will help you tremendously in winning the tournament.

UPGRADES

You can buy tips from the Captain on how to improve your fishing skills and catch more fish, the only thing he asks in return is a part of the very same fish that you need to win. Why does it take fish and not money? First of all because in the North Pole there isn't much use for money, and second because he just LOVES eating fish.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan compatible graphic card
  • Storage: 150 MB available space

short_description: A fishing & exploration game where you are stranded in the North Pole as part of the yearly "Fishathon", a fierce 7-day tournament where only the best fisherman will come out on top and win a mysterious yet alluring prize.
